reviews.title: Wrong jacket rigth girl
reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star

Terrible experience. I paid to watch a story because I was interested in seeing how it ended, only to find out that after just 20 episodes, it simply stops — there is no ending and apparently the remaining episodes haven’t even been released yet.

The app should make it VERY CLEAR before taking your money that the story is incomplete and that additional episodes are still pending. Customers are paying expecting to have access to the full story, not to discover afterward that they paid for an unfinished series.

I feel misled and extremely disappointed. If I had known there were only 20 episodes available and that I wouldn’t be able to finish the story, I would never have paid for it.

I definitely do not recommend paying for any series on this app unless you first confirm that ALL episodes are actually available.

You “finish” movies completely unsatisfied and  you feel as though your hour or more was wasted. It has caused me so much frustration that before I start any movie, I go to the end to make sure I am satisfied with the outcome, ruining the movie for myself. 

There needs to be a tag that lets you know this is “part 1” or “cliff hanger” or “unhappy ending” to avoid movies like this. There are too many to NOT have their own genre. 

I don’t want to renew because to me, half stories aren’t stories and they aren’t satisfying… please fix this!
